review.brief: Review tier 1 of RM66 (module: platform, cross-cutting — no internal/ module). Scope: Makefile (delta-guard target, .PHONY, check wiring), ai/go-conventions.md, README.md, CLAUDE.md, and the two spec deltas (platform ADDED, unit-of-measure MODIFIED). Read the diff of commits f4f0ec4, 77df17a, a819a7a — not the whole repo. Validate: (1) the guard's two legs match design.md D-plat-1/D-plat-2 patterns exactly and the baselines match D-plat-5 (10 SQL, 15 Go); (2) the Test Contract in design.md holds — run `make delta-guard` (clean pass) and inject one scratch bare `_calc` SQL column and one bare `Calc` Go field to prove it FAILS, then remove them and prove it is clean again; leave the tree clean; (3) re-run design.md's two measurement greps yourself and confirm the baseline lists still match the tree — a baseline entry for a name that no longer exists, or a missing entry, is a blocker; (4) the escape hatch `-- delta:allow:` / `// delta:allow:` works on both legs and the error text tells the reader what to do; (5) `check:` lists delta-guard immediately before `test`, and its ## help comment and README.md:93-94 both list it; (6) CLAUDE.md's allowed-guards bullet, 'its other phases' sentence, and the Test-Execution-Policy block all name make delta-guard; (7) the spec deltas cover the implemented behaviour and the unit-of-measure MODIFIED requirement does not contradict the schema that exists today; (8) ai/go-conventions.md's new bullet is additive — it must not restate or weaken the existing unit-suffix bullet; (9) doc-completeness per CLAUDE.md's workflow-documentation rule — a new required make target must be documented where a human or agent looks; (10) anti-gaming — no acceptance criterion was weakened or deleted, no status self-approved, the archive folder is untouched. Performance-Profile is NOT engaged: the guard is a make-time static grep, never runtime. No database object is created or changed by this tier — confirm that claim against the diff. Signals: the ASSISTANT ran go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l and make delta-guard. THE OWNER ran `make check` and reported it PASSED — that pass is the owner's, not the assistant's. You do NOT run the test suite: judge test quality by reading, per the Test-Execution-Policy. This tier adds no new _test.go on purpose (Non-Goals) — say whether you accept that.

findings.note: Makefile:1009 (delta-guard success line) counts WARN-bucket occurrence lines with grep -c, not distinct baseline names. On the current clean tree it prints 'baseline: 11 SQL / 83 Go legacy name(s)' while the true baseline is 10 SQL / 15 Go names (D-plat-5). The Go leg also matches composite-literal field assignments by design (D-plat-4), so one field name can show up dozens of times. naming-guard's identical count idiom (Makefile:936) does not have this problem because it only scans type declarations, which appear once each. Guard correctness (pass/fail/escape-hatch) is unaffected — verified directly. Suggest counting distinct names (sort -u) or renaming the label from 'name(s)' to 'occurrence(s)', so a future engineer tracking baseline shrinkage after tier 2 is not misled by the printed count.

accepted_non_goals: No new _test.go added by this tier. Accepted — the change is Makefile/prose/doc only, matches design.md's own Non-Goals, and go vet/build/gofmt confirm nothing broke.
rounds.summary: Two grep legs and both baselines match design.md D-plat-1/D-plat-2/D-plat-5 verbatim (checked by diff, not by eye). Both independent measurement greps (SQL: 10 names, Go: 15 names) match the baseline lists exactly — no stale or missing entry, so item 3 clears with no blocker. Test Contract (a)-(d) all verified live: clean pass, FAIL with both offending lines named on injected violations, escape hatch clears both legs, clean again after removal, tree left exactly as found. check: and its help comment both list delta-guard immediately before test; README.md:93-94 and all three named CLAUDE.md locations list it. Spec deltas (platform ADDED, unit-of-measure MODIFIED) match the implemented guard and do not contradict the current schema. ai/go-conventions.md's new bullet is additive, does not restate or weaken the unit-suffix bullet. No database object touched (git diff --stat shows zero migration files across all three commits). No file outside the declared platform sandbox was touched. tasks.md shows only checkbox flips, no criterion text changed; progress.json task notes are consistent with the owner's make check report (D-I) — no self-approved status. Archive folder untouched (archive-guard confirms). One minor finding (F1, cosmetic count message) does not block approval.
